mechanism: Micafungin may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing haloperidol metabolism and clearance, though haloperidol is primarily metabolized by CYP2D6; additive QT prolongation risk exists with both agents.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; assess for increased haloperidol side effects; consider alternative antifungal if prolonged QT present or use with caution with dose adjustment if necessary.
